title: Draw WorldEnvironment volumetric fog
abstract:
`volumetric_fog_*` on an Environment draws nothing. Godot draws a froxel volume that scatters the lights and the ambient into the view. `unit-world-environment-basic` turns it on, so it is the largest error of that golden (mean 66.25 against Godot on the whole image).

## What to do

1. Read Godot's volumetric fog pass (`servers/rendering/renderer_rd/environment/fog.cpp` and its shaders) for density, albedo, emission, anisotropy, length, detail spread, the ambient and sky inject, and the temporal reprojection.
2. Port it to the previewer as a pass that fills a froxel volume and composites it over the scene, in the web previewer and the VS Code extension through the shared core.
3. Measure `unit-world-environment-basic` with `pnpm ref:godot`, before and after.

## Context

PR #649 found this golden moves slightly further from Godot (mean 66.24 to 66.25) because the fog is missing, not because of the PR's ambient change. The environment sheet lists it as **Not drawn**.
